task: Integrate official BukSU Secretary's Minutes (Form OVPAA-F-INS-032) into Secretary Review Studio with OCR document scanning, accurate autofill, zero starting values, and ADM synchronization

evidence.zero_starting_values: INITIAL_MINUTES_STATE initializes with empty strings and empty arrays across all fields
evidence.buksu_form_replicated: Form OVPAA-F-INS-032 (Revision No: 01, Issue No: 01, Issue Date: June 1, 2018) rendered with BukSU letterhead, 2-column Comments Matrix, checkmarks, verdict, and Secretary signature block
evidence.ocr_autofill_accuracy: Backend OCR parser extracts title, proponents, defense type checkmark, round checkmark, date/time/venue, committee roster, panel comments, recommendations, verdict, and secretary name
evidence.sync_to_adm: One-click synchronization maps parsed remarks directly into Action Done Matrix rows with milestone binding and automatically unlocks endorsement review
evidence.playwright_visual_audit: Captured desktop and mobile viewports in light and dark modes (scratch/secretary_minutes_desktop_light.png, scratch/secretary_form_032_scrolled.png, scratch/secretary_form_032_verdict.png)

lessons_learned: Lesson: Institutional form checkmarks in OCR text often precede their label (e.g. `(✓) Prototype Defense`). Trailing parenthesis matching must be guarded against to avoid false positive checkmark detection on subsequent unchecked items.
Lesson: Normalize whitespace runs before ordinal matching (e.g. `1\nst (✓) 2\nnd` -> `1st (✓) 2nd`) to prevent regex failures on multiline OCR outputs.

Lesson: The Secretary Review page must allow viewing projects where `isArchived: true` (`excludeArchived: false`) so that faculty appointed as Secretary can inspect past hearing minutes and Action Done Matrix records.
